__inputs.name: DS_FROGSHARE
__inputs.label: FrogShare (Supabase)
__inputs.description: O PostgreSQL do Supabase, com o login grafana_reader

title: FrogShare
description: Quem transmite, quem assiste, erros e Cloudflare. Só números, sem ids de sala nem de pessoas.

list.name: versao
list.label: Versão do app
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(app_version, '?') FROM monitoring.host_quality WHERE time > now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY 1 DESC
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT coalesce(app_version, '?') FROM monitoring.host_quality WHERE time > now() - interval '30 days' ORDER BY 1 DESC

target.rawSql: SELECT min(time) AS time, 'FrogShare ' || app_version || ': primeira transmissão nesta versão' AS text, 'versão' AS tags FROM monitoring.host_quality WHERE app_version IS NOT NULL GROUP BY app_version HAVING min(time) BETWEEN $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND $__timeTo()::timestamptz

panels.title: Resumo

targets.rawSql: SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM monitoring.viewer_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) / 60.0 AS "horas assistidas", ((SELECT count(*) FROM monitoring.host_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) + (SELECT count(*) FROM monitoring.web_host_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time))) / 60.0 AS "horas transmitidas", (SELECT 100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN freezes = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) FROM monitoring.viewer_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) AS "imagem fluida", (SELECT avg(avg_fps) FROM monitoring.viewer_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND avg_fps IS NOT NULL) AS "fps de quem assiste", (SELECT count(*) FROM monitoring.errors WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) AS "erros"

panels.description: Imagem fluida: parte dos minutos assistidos sem nenhuma travada. Cada pessoa assistindo ou transmitindo manda um relatório por minuto.

panels.title: Ao vivo agora

targets.rawSql: WITH last AS (SELECT * FROM monitoring.server_stats WHERE time > now() - interval '12 minutes' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT coalesce((SELECT streams FROM last), 0) AS "transmissões", coalesce((SELECT viewers FROM last), 0) AS "assistindo", coalesce((SELECT rooms_live FROM last), 0) AS "salas", coalesce((SELECT sfu_streams FROM last), 0) AS "pelo servidor de mídia"

panels.description: Do retrato que o servidor grava a cada 5 minutos enquanto está acordado. Dormindo (ninguém usando há 15 minutos), é zero.

panels.title: Cloudflare no mês

targets.rawSql: SELECT cloudflare_gb AS usado FROM monitoring.server_stats WHERE cloudflare_gb IS NOT NULL AND time > date_trunc('month', now()) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1

panels.description: Relay e servidor de mídia somados, como a Cloudflare cobra. O servidor deixa de usar os dois perto de 900 GB.

panels.title: Projeção do mês

targets.rawSql: WITH last AS (SELECT cloudflare_gb, cloudflare_cap_gb FROM monitoring.server_stats WHERE cloudflare_gb IS NOT NULL AND time > date_trunc('month', now()) ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1), k AS (SELECT greatest(extract(epoch FROM now() - date_trunc('month', now())) / 86400.0, 1) AS passed, extract(day FROM date_trunc('month', now()) + interval '1 month - 1 day') AS total) SELECT round(cloudflare_gb / passed * total, 0) AS "no fim do mês", round(100.0 * cloudflare_gb / passed * total / nullif(cloudflare_cap_gb, 0), 0) AS "do limite" FROM last, k

panels.description: No ritmo do mês até agora.

panels.title: Ao vivo ao longo do tempo

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '5m', NULL), max(streams) AS "transmissões", max(viewers) AS "assistindo", max(sfu_streams) AS "pelo servidor de mídia" FROM monitoring.server_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Travadas

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '15m', NULL), avg(freezes) AS "travadas por minuto", avg(frozen_s) AS "segundos parados por minuto", 100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN freezes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "% dos minutos com travada" FROM monitoring.viewer_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Média por pessoa, de minuto em minuto, como a página da sala mede.

panels.title: FPS de quem assiste

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '15m', NULL), avg(avg_fps) AS "média", percentile_cont(0.1) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY avg_fps::float8) AS "pior 10%" FROM monitoring.viewer_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND avg_fps IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Os 10% piores minutos mostram quem está sofrendo, mesmo quando a média vai bem.

panels.title: Por que travou (minutos)

targets.rawSql: SELECT diagnosis AS motivo, count(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis LIKE '%quem transmite%') AS "lado de quem transmite", count(*) FILTER (WHERE diagnosis LIKE '%quem assiste%') AS "lado de quem assiste" FROM monitoring.viewer_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND diagnosis <> 'sem problema' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY count(*) DESC

panels.description: O diagnóstico que a própria página da sala faz em cada minuto com travada.

panels.title: Atraso e perda

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '15m', NULL), avg(rtt_ms / 2.0 + buffer_ms) AS "atraso até a tela", avg(loss_pct) AS "perda de pacotes" FROM monitoring.viewer_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Atraso: metade do ida e volta da rede mais o tempo no buffer de quem assiste. Perda acima de 2% já trava.

panels.title: Como a imagem chega

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT via_sfu AND NOT via_relay) AS "direto", count(*) FILTER (WHERE via_relay AND NOT via_sfu) AS "relay (TURN)", count(*) FILTER (WHERE via_sfu) AS "servidor de mídia" FROM monitoring.viewer_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time)

panels.description: Direto não custa nada. Relay e servidor de mídia passam pela Cloudflare e contam no limite do mês.

panels.title: Resolução que chega

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE h >= 1000) AS "1080p ou mais", count(*) FILTER (WHERE h >= 700 AND h < 1000) AS "720p", count(*) FILTER (WHERE h >= 500 AND h < 700) AS "540p", count(*) FILTER (WHERE h < 500) AS "menor" FROM (SELECT monitoring.num(split_part(resolution, 'x', 2)) AS h FROM monitoring.viewer_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time)) r

panels.description: Altura da imagem que chega a quem assiste. Ultrawide em 1080p chega com menos de 1080 de altura.

targets.rawSql: SELECT browser || ' (' || platform || ')' AS navegador, count(*) AS minutos FROM monitoring.viewer_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 8

panels.title: Versões em uso (minutos transmitidos)

targets.rawSql: SELECT versao, minutos FROM ( SELECT coalesce(app_version, '?') AS versao, count(*) AS minutos FROM monitoring.host_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'navegador' AS versao, count(*) AS minutos FROM monitoring.web_host_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) ) v WHERE minutos > 0 ORDER BY minutos DESC

panels.description: Mostra se a atualização automática chegou em todo mundo.

panels.title: Codificação: placa de vídeo × processador

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '15m', NULL), sum(links_gpu) / 15.0 AS "placa de vídeo", sum(links_cpu) / 15.0 AS "processador" FROM monitoring.host_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('__all' IN ($versao) OR coalesce(app_version, '?') IN ($versao)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Quantas cópias da imagem estão sendo codificadas ao mesmo tempo, em média. Pelo processador pesa no jogo.

panels.title: FPS de quem transmite

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '15m', NULL), avg(capture_fps) AS "captura", avg(pipeline_fps) AS "depois do redesenho", avg(sent_fps) AS "enviado" FROM monitoring.host_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('__all' IN ($versao) OR coalesce(app_version, '?') IN ($versao)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Captura abaixo do enviado: tela parada ou jogo travando. Enviado bem abaixo do redesenho: o codificador não deu conta.

panels.title: Aperto no PC de quem transmite

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '15m', NULL), 100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN auto_fps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "em 30 fps automático", 100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN cpu_limited THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "limitado pelo processador", 100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN bandwidth_limited THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS "limitado pela internet" FROM monitoring.host_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('__all' IN ($versao) OR coalesce(app_version, '?') IN ($versao)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Parte dos minutos transmitidos em cada situação.

panels.title: Upload de quem transmite

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '15m', NULL), avg(upload_kbps) * 1000 AS "média por transmissão", max(upload_kbps) * 1000 AS "maior" FROM monitoring.host_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('__all' IN ($versao) OR coalesce(app_version, '?') IN ($versao)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Somando as cópias que cada transmissão manda (uma por pessoa, ou uma só pelo servidor de mídia).

panels.title: Redesenho e codificação por quadro

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '15m', NULL), avg(draw_ms) AS "redesenho", avg(encode_ms) AS "codificação" FROM monitoring.host_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('__all' IN ($versao) OR coalesce(app_version, '?') IN ($versao)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Tempo de cada quadro no redesenho pela placa e no codificador. A 60 fps, cada quadro tem 16 ms ao todo.

panels.title: Placas de vídeo de quem transmite

targets.rawSql: SELECT coalesce(gpu_model, '?') AS placa, count(*) AS minutos, round(100.0 * sum(links_cpu) / nullif(sum(links), 0), 0) AS "% no processador", round(avg(sent_fps), 0) AS "fps enviado", round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN auto_fps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "% em 30 automático", round(avg(encode_ms), 1) AS "codificação (ms)" FROM monitoring.host_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('__all' IN ($versao) OR coalesce(app_version, '?') IN ($versao)) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15

panels.description: Placas que codificam no processador ou vivem em 30 fps automático são as que mais sofrem.

panels.title: Captura de tela

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE capture = 'wgc') AS "rápida (WGC)", count(*) FILTER (WHERE capture = 'dxgi') AS "antiga (DXGI)", count(*) FILTER (WHERE capture IS NULL OR capture NOT IN ('wgc', 'dxgi')) AS "outra (Mac, versões antigas)" FROM monitoring.host_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('__all' IN ($versao) OR coalesce(app_version, '?') IN ($versao))

panels.description: A captura antiga (DXGI) fica em ~32 fps e pesa mais no jogo.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) FILTER (WHERE platform = 'Windows') AS "Windows", count(*) FILTER (WHERE platform = 'Mac') AS "Mac", count(*) FILTER (WHERE platform NOT IN ('Windows', 'Mac')) AS "outro" FROM monitoring.host_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND ('__all' IN ($versao) OR coalesce(app_version, '?') IN ($versao))

panels.title: Pelo navegador

targets.rawSql: SELECT browser || ' (' || platform || ')' AS navegador, count(*) AS minutos, round(avg(sent_fps), 0) AS "fps enviado", round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN auto_fps THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "% em 30 automático", round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN piped THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "% pela placa de vídeo", round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN mode = 'sfu' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS "% no servidor de mídia", round(avg(upload_kbps) / 1000.0, 1) AS "upload (Mbps)" FROM monitoring.web_host_quality WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.description: Transmissões feitas em transmitir.html, por navegador.

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '1h', 0), origin AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM monitoring.errors WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Erros mais comuns

targets.rawSql: SELECT message AS erro, origin AS onde, string_agg(DISTINCT coalesce(app_version, '?'), ', ') AS "versões", count(*) AS vezes, max(time) AS "último" FROM monitoring.errors WHERE $__timeFilter(time) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT 30

panels.description: Números e códigos viram N e # para erros iguais se juntarem.

panels.title: Erros novos

targets.rawSql: SELECT e.message AS erro, e.origin AS onde, count(*) AS vezes, min(e.time) AS "primeira vez" FROM monitoring.errors e WHERE $__timeFilter(e.time) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM monitoring.errors o WHERE o.message = e.message AND o.time < $__timeFrom()::timestamptz AND o.time > $__timeFrom()::timestamptz - interval '30 days') GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT 30

panels.description: Erros do período escolhido que não apareceram nos 30 dias antes dele: o que uma versão nova trouxe.

panels.title: Uso no mês

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(time, '1h', NULL), max(cloudflare_gb) AS "total", max(cloudflare_sfu_gb) AS "servidor de mídia", max(cloudflare_relay_gb) AS "relay (TURN)" FROM monitoring.server_stats WHERE $__timeFilter(time) AND cloudflare_gb IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Acumulado do mês, como a Cloudflare conta. A linha tracejada é o limite do servidor (900 GB).
